notablePrerequisites:
Combat Celebrant cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ardenn triggers, attaching the Equipment that grants haste and Sword of Hearth and Home to Combat Celebrant.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Combat Celebrant
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Combat Celebrant, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Combat Celebrant from exile onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.
